mintAuthority.summary: MetaMask USD is an M0-backed extension with one canonical native issuance route on Ethereum. Base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway, and Ethereum MUSD wrapping routes through the M0 SwapFacility. Linea and Monad MUSD are M0 Portal-backed representations; their token, SwapFacility, Portal, adapter, and validator controls are assessed under bridgeRouteRisk and are excluded from native Mint Authority posture.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing MUSD depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders). M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold. MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint. Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable; MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy and Registrar governance remains the parameter authority.

controls.label: MUSD token upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770417, the canonical MUSD proxy's EIP-1967 admin is ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9. ProxyAdmin owner() returns TimelockController 0x7701f4fa4592f59a6cd0e3ac1c182b3c3173c280, whose 259,200-second delay and 3-of-5 Safe proposer, executor, and canceller path govern the Ethereum native MUSD proxy. getMinDelay() returned 259,200 seconds for the Ethereum MUSD upgrade timelock. The Linea and Monad proxy implementation/admin observations remain preserved in bridgeRouteRisk controls as representation upgrade facts.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531380, SwapFacility remained a TransparentUpgradeableProxy using implementation 0x45bf08d042a8958f01f8e8319b791e4584550da8. The canonical EIP-1967 admin slot 0xb5312768...d6103 returned ProxyAdmin 0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924, and the proxy runtime independently embedded the same immutable admin address. ProxyAdmin owner() returned TimelockController 0x23ca665c8a73292fc7ac2cc4493d2ce883bba468 (3-day minDelay=259200s). Timelock proposer was Gnosis Safe 0xb7a9b5f301ef3bad36c2b4964e82931dd7fb989c (5 owners, threshold 3); executor was 0xf2f1acbe0ba726fee8d75f3e32900526874740bb. SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply; extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply. SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap. Ethereum SwapFacility is controlled by ProxyAdmin -> TimelockController with a 3-day delay and Gnosis Safe proposer; canRaiseCap=true via M0 TTG governance.

review.evidence: The native Mint Authority scope is Ethereum only. The immutable Ethereum MinterGateway creates base M subject to approved-minter, validator-attestation, mint-delay, collateral/debt, and M0 TTG controls; Ethereum MUSD wraps that M through the SwapFacility, whose upgradeable wrapper path is governed by the reviewed Ethereum ProxyAdmin and three-day timelock. Linea and Monad MUSD/SwapFacility proxy observations, M0 Portal and Hyperlane adapter controls, peer configuration, pauses, and validator sets are representation facts preserved under bridgeRouteRisk and excluded from this native posture. Economic fields remain scoped to continuous M-backed reconciliation and M0-governed raiseable issuance parameters.
